title: BKRS Step 5.1 Canonical Concept Registry and Normalization Specification

meta.phase: Milestone 5.1 — Canonical Concept Registry & Normalization Adapter
meta.immutability_rule: Strictly read-only; zero mutation of Book Masters

mapping_states.definition: Identical concept with identical operational scope, definition, and domain applicability.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Verbatim or formal propositional identity; matching domain boundaries and non-divergent boundary conditions.
mapping_states.prohibition: Embedding or semantic similarity alone must NEVER assign this state.

mapping_states.definition: Concepts operating with identical systemic, behavioral, or causal roles despite minor stylistic phrasing differences.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Demonstrable mapping of all primary functional inputs, mechanisms, and outcomes.
mapping_states.prohibition: Must not span across radically incompatible philosophical frameworks.

mapping_states.definition: Concepts sharing a core operational mechanism but diverging substantially in scope, normative goal, or peripheral boundary conditions.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Explicit identification of the intersection set and the divergence set with textual citations.
mapping_states.prohibition: Must not be summarized as simple agreement.

mapping_states.definition: Concepts addressing the same broad human or societal domain that do not share core definitions or mechanisms.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Demonstrable shared thematic anchor accompanied by proof of distinct operational mechanisms.
mapping_states.prohibition: Cannot be used to transfer empirical evidence or conclusions.

mapping_states.definition: Structural isomorphism between principles operating in completely distinct operational domains.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Explicit domain boundary declaration (e.g., Domain A: Capital Markets vs Domain B: Revolutionary Ideological Training) and isomorphism mapping.
mapping_states.prohibition: Must never imply causation or shared empirical substance.

mapping_states.definition: Lexical identity masking fundamentally different conceptual definitions.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Textual citations demonstrating identical term usage with conflicting definitional criteria.
mapping_states.prohibition: Must strictly override automated keyword or vector clustering.

mapping_states.definition: Different lexical terms denoting the exact same operational or philosophical principle.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Rigorous definitional concordance proving identical scope, mechanism, and outcomes.
mapping_states.prohibition: Requires human review certification before entering production.

mapping_states.definition: Book-specific concept that has not yet been mapped to a canonical concept in the registry.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Valid BookSpecificConcept object present in adapter output.
mapping_states.prohibition: Cannot participate in cross-book synthesis units.

mapping_states.definition: Candidate mapping where evidence is conflicting, incomplete, or borderline.
mapping_states.minimum_evidence_required: Audit log entry documenting the specific ambiguity.
mapping_states.prohibition: Blocked from production synthesis until human review certification.

validation_rules.rule: All 138 canonical units (36 NW + 24 PM + 78 BS) must be projected into NormalizedCrossBookUnit with 0 omissions.
Zero duplicate source_unit_id references across the normalized layer.
Orphan Check: Any normalized unit failing to resolve to an immutable Book Master unit halts the pipeline.
Mutation Check: Canonical Book Master file SHA-256 hashes must remain identical before and after adapter execution.
Zero epistemic status mutation: The normalized epistemic_status must strictly match the Book Master string.
Zero voice mutation: Fictional characters, narrators, authors, biographers, and historical subjects must remain segregated.
Zero materiality mutation: Critical, Important, and Textural ratings must be preserved exactly.
Zero temporal substitution: Event time must never be substituted for record time.
Zero provenance loss: Source file path, element IDs, and verbatim quotes must survive projection.
Zero causal upgrading: Causal edges must carry explicit categories and cannot be converted to cross-book claims.
Zero competing-account collapse: Disputed historical issues must retain segregated witness accounts.
Zero genre collapse: Encapsulated genre payloads must remain accessible via reference pointers.

governance_invariants.book_master_supremacy: Book Masters are immutable and authoritative. Normalization is a secondary, read-only derivation.
governance_invariants.precedence_rule: If any normalization projection conflicts with an underlying Book Master, the Book Master wins unconditionally.
governance_invariants.orphan_policy: Orphan normalized units are strictly forbidden and cause immediate validation failure.
governance_invariants.concept_freeze_policy: No automated concept mappings may be committed to production without passing the 8 adversarial test criteria.
